calibration_choice.rule: held-out FA <= 0.025 (K and C), then highest pooled selection detection, ties -> simpler

correlator_choice.rule: held-out events per clean hour <= 10.0 (K and C), then highest pooled event detection, ties -> simpler

blame_choice.rule: wrong blame <= 0.1 (K and C), then highest mean correct, ties -> majority_all

exposure: 4th scoring of fusion test data (S3, S4, S5 before) on a NEW random pairing of the domain test streams (seed [42, 66, 5, ord(family)]); every domain test set was scored before (KITTI LiDAR test drives: 8th exposure; ROAD >= 6x, D10 several, VeReMi 2x, comma 2x)

coupling.model: INS position follows the spoofed GNSS 1:1 (worst case), yaw unchanged; L2c / L2d recomputed from raw scans with the shifted pose; control = the same scans with the true pose, synchronised with the GPS run

A3_K_event_detection_single.rule: >= 0.70 (single-domain families; comparison rows and LiDAR episodes excluded)

A5_K_blame.rule: correct >= 0.75 and wrong <= 0.10 (detected single-domain K events, pooled; decided-majority event blame)

A6_safe_stop_per_clean_hour.rule: <= 1 (K and C; SAFE_STOP needs >= 2 corroborating domains)

coupling_test.rule: reported, not judged (GPS families, mean over drift / accel_drift / doppler_spoof / meaconing)
